signals.text: Coventry out of bottom three with win over struggling Sunderland. Frank Lampard's Coventry City lift themselves out of the relegation zone after beating struggling Sunderland, who remain rooted to the bottom of the Premier League table.

Sunderland's paradox - San Siro trip amid relegation battle. Sunderland were last season's surprise package in the Premier League, but this time they are struggling after Coventry handed them their sixth defeat.
